name: Yurihonjo (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Yurihonjo city emblem in white: a stylised flower of five petals with pointed ends.
history: Municipal flag of Yurihonjo, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Yurihonjo city emblem — a stylised flower of five petals with pointed ends
